description: Fix for the fused_diazine_quinazoline_quinoxaline_purine cluster (33/84) diagnosed in fix/aromaticity-flag-demotion-k2b (PR #145). Root cause: ring_pi_electrons (and its diagnostic mirror evaluate_atom_pi_contribution_inner) carbon branch CarbonExocyclicHeteroatomDouble rule tested only "is the double-bond partner outside THIS ring atom set" to decide "genuine exocyclic substituent" -- a ring-fusion bond into an adjacent ring at a heteroatom passed that same test, wrongly zeroing the fusion carbon and (when both fusion atoms were affected) landing the ring on pi=4 Antiaromatic, which Pass 1 marks non-retryable, permanently excluding it from Pass 2.
fix: Replaced the ring_atom_set-based exocyclic check with a bond-level all_ring_bonds set (built once per assign_aromaticity_ex call from every SSSR/augmented ring via the existing ring_bond_set helper, O(total ring length), no repeated SSSR/DFS work). A double bond only counts as a genuine exocyclic substituent if its bond is on NO ring at all; a bond into a DIFFERENT ring is a ring-fusion bond and now falls through to the ordinary sp2 default (1pi), matching how a fusion carbon whose double bond points at an all-carbon neighbor already behaved (naphthalene-style). Applied identically to both ring_pi_electrons (production) and evaluate_atom_pi_contribution_inner (the documented always-in-lockstep diagnostic mirror, per trace_matches_ring_pi_electrons_on_corpus).

cluster_resolution.still_mismatched_reason: Compound cases: the fused-diazine mechanism inside these molecules IS fixed (verified via per-atom trace -- the fusion benzo ring now correctly reaches Aromatic pi=6 in Pass 1), but a SECOND, independent, out-of-scope mechanism in a different fused ring of the same molecule (an oxazole/pyran-type ring landing on a genuinely odd Pass-1 count that Pass 2 cannot help, since the shared cross-ring atoms already scored 1pi identically before and after context) still blocks full-molecule RDKit agreement -- same character as the large_polycyclic_sssr_special_case (2/84) and azulene_type_nonalternant (49/84) clusters, both explicitly out of scope for this fix. All 4 share the same etamycin-like macrolactam aromatic core; only one was traced in full detail, the other 3 are near-identical scaffolds (different N-alkyl substituent lengths).

corpus_5000_kekulized_convention.note: before/after both computed via crates/chematic-perception/examples/aromaticity_flag_corpus_dump.rs on this exact branch, compared per-atom against a live rdkit==2026.03.3 ground truth (not assumed). 0 new mismatches confirmed in both directions.

corpus_5000_raw_convention.note: unaffected, as expected (the raw convention never exercises ring_pi_electrons demotion the same way -- unchanged before and after).

beneficial_side_effects_verified_live_vs.description: The same general mechanism fix (not molecule-specific) also resolves two PRE-EXISTING, separately-tracked bug buckets in this same test module, because they share the identical root cause (a fusion carbon double-bond pointing at an adjacent ring heteroatom). Not attempted or targeted -- discovered as a consequence of fixing the shared rule. Zero cluster-specific code was written.

side_effects_not_resolved.KNOWN_ORDER_DEPENDENT_FALSE_NEGATIVES: 2 of 3 pinned counts shifted (16->12) as a side effect of the same general fix, but remain WRONG vs RDKit by a different amount (still off by 8, was off by 4/8/4) -- a separate, pre-existing, multi-causal bug in this molecule class, confirmed unrelated to and not fixed by this PR. Pinned to the new current-wrong values.

oracle_40_fixture_check.result: IDENTICAL before and after this fix (A/B tested via git stash): 4 fixtures (azulene, selenophene, tellurophene, phosphole) report unexpected_mismatch/baseline drift against the frozen EXPECTED_BUCKET_BY_ID table on BOTH the unmodified K2b commit and this fix -- i.e. this fix causes ZERO changes to the 40-fixture oracle. This drift PRE-DATES this PR: it was already present on the K2b commit before any fused-diazine work started (K2b own demotion change was never reconciled with this frozen Python table; its comment still says K2b is a separate, not-yet-merged PR). Root causes (azulene non-alternant model gap; missing Se/Te/P Huckel support) are out of scope for this fix and not touched. scripts/aromaticity_rdkit_parity_diagnosis.py itself was left untouched (reverted an exploratory edit) -- reconciling its frozen table with K2b landing is K2b housekeeping debt, not part of this follow-up.

remaining_84_cluster_total_after_this_fi.note: 49 + 4 + 2 = 55, matches the measured corpus after-mismatch count exactly. The 4 compound cases were originally counted under fused_diazine (33) but structurally belong with the large_polycyclic-shaped mechanism once the fused-diazine component of their failure is fixed.

hard_rule_compliance: No molecule-specific allowlist or SMILES-based exception list. Fix is bond-level ring membership (all_ring_bonds), a general, whole-molecule mechanism -- verified: it fires identically for the minimal repro, all 33 cluster molecules, and (as a side effect) the unrelated bridgehead-N/purine cases, using the exact same code path with zero conditionals on molecule identity.
